# Z80 test programs

`zexdoc.com` and `zexall.com` are the Z80 instruction set exercisers by
Frank D. Cringle (Copyright (C) 1994), distributed under the GNU General
Public License v2 or later. They are CP/M programs: the tests in this package
load them at 0x0100 and emulate the two BDOS console calls they use.

`zexdoc` checks documented flag behaviour; `zexall` also checks the
undocumented flag bits 3 and 5.
